title: Drunk Teacher Snaps, Hits Pregnant Woman in Crash
description:
On Easter Sunday in Palm Beach County, Florida, police responded to a multi-vehicle crash allegedly caused by Nathaniel Rayman, a 50-year-old teacher who'd been drinking heavily amid a troubled separation from his wife. Watch the investigation unfold on Law&Crime BodyCam.
